lastCompletedStory.title: Guard empty/whitespace branchName in runPostAuditAction (never git checkout -b '')

nextStoryContext: US-004 added an empty-branch guard in runPostAuditAction (before the git checkout -b call on the proceed-branch path): when branchName.trim()==='' it calls notifyFn best-effort and returns no-action, which exitPhaseAfterPlan maps to idle. The git calls were extracted into a helper executeGitProceedBranch to keep runPostAuditAction under biome's cognitive-complexity limit (was at 15 with the new if, extracted to bring it back to ~7). New test file: test/plan-runner-empty-branch.test.ts with 26 unit tests proving AC1 (empty/whitespace branchName: no git checkout, notifyFn called, no-action result, maps to idle), AC2 (recording spawnFn never sees checkout -b with empty arg), AC3 (sidecar fallback branchName='' escalates cleanly). All quality gates pass (2647 tests, typecheck clean, check:all exit 0).

officialDocsValidated.summary: All changes are in internal cam-cli modules (plan-runner.ts guard + test file). No external npm library was added or changed.
